verdict.rationale: The axis applies: the RX 9070 XT ships with the ROCm software stack, whose libraries (hipBLAS, hipRAND and others) have APIs a vendor could document interactively. The evidence shows no interactive API reference with runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The AI Developer Hub's Jupyter Notebook tutorials are runnable, but they are tutorials, an adjacent feature rather than an explorable API reference, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
